On 2025-08-07 the FAA released an Aviation Safety Workforce Plan to hire about 4,600 safety inspectors and engineers through 2034. The FAA Administrator confirmed on 2025-07-09 came from outside the agency as a regional airline chief executive, which differs from the internal promotion the text asks to consider.
